item.title: Ottawa Senators make it four straight with victory over Pittsburgh Penguins
item.description: The Ottawa Senators got the job done in Steeltown on Monday night. The Senators extended their winning streak to four straight games with a hard-fought 3-2 victory over Sidney Crosby and the Pittsburgh Penguins at PPG Paints Arena. Claude Giroux scored the winner, while Tim Stutzle and Michael Amadio also chipped in with goals as […]

item.title: Senators player grades: Giroux clutch, Stutzle with mind-bending assist in win over Penguins
item.description: All of Tim Stutzle's offensive talents were on display, Claude Giroux did something impressive every shift, Michael Amadio ended a lengthy scoring drought, and Linus Ullmark was reliable enough in a 3-2 win against the Pittsburgh Penguins.
